events.title: Status quo maintained as 토트넘 홋스퍼 win at 아스널 and 에버턴 beat 루턴 타운. 스토크 시티 suffer another pasting, this time 4–0 at 코번트리 시티. Peter Beardsley scores a hat-trick as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 선덜랜드 3–1. In Division Two, 풀럼 stage a remarkable fightback from 4–0 down to draw 4–4 at 포츠머스.

FA Cup third round shocks include Orient's 2–1 win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 퀸스 파크 레인저스' 1–0 defeat at 동커스터 로버스. 버턴 앨비언 are beaten 6–1 by 레스터 시티 at the Baseball Ground after their goalkeeper Paul Evans is left dazed by a missile thrown from the crowd with the score level at 1–1. The FA subsequently orders the match to be replayed. Trouble too at Highfield Road where 맨체스터 시티 fans riot as their side go down 2–1 to 코번트리 시티. Telford United knock out Third Division leaders 브래드퍼드 시티 but Dagenham are beaten at 칼라일 유나이티드 . 헤리퍼드 유나이티드, second in Division Four, hold 아스널 and 위건 애슬레틱 draw at 첼시 after being two goals ahead. At White Hart Lane, Mark Aizlewood earns 찰턴 애슬레틱 a replay with a scrambled equaliser after seeing his initial penalty saved by Ray Clemence . Luther Blissett scores four in 왓퍼드's 5–0 drubbing of 셰필드 유나이티드 .
Fourth Division 달링턴 beat 미들즈브러 2–1 in an FA Cup replay at Feethams . The match is held up for 10 minutes during the second half following a pitch invasion.
Only two FA Cup replays survive as cold weather begins to bite. 루턴 타운 score two early goals on their way to a 3–2 win at 스토크 시티 while 노팅엄 포리스트 win 3–1 in extra time at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.

토트넘 홋스퍼 are held to a 2–2 draw at 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and relinquish the league leadership to 에버턴 who beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–0. A frozen pitch causes 선덜랜드's match with 리버풀 at Roker Park to be abandoned at half-time. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are beaten 1–0 by 코번트리 시티, their second successive home defeat, and lose captain Bryan Robson to a shoulder injury.

레스터 시티 win their replayed FA Cup tie with 버턴 앨비언 1–0 behind closed doors at Highfield Road. 노리치 시티 are the first team through to the semi-finals of the Milk Cup following a 1–0 win at 그림즈비 타운. 유벤투스 beat 리버풀 2–0 in Turin to win the European Super Cup . Polish international striker Zbigniew Boniek scores both goals.

Arctic conditions decimate today's fixture programme with only 10 matches played across the four divisions. Three survive in the First Division – 리버풀 beat 노리치 시티 4–0 while 애스턴 빌라 win 3–0 at 코번트리 시티 and 첼시 draw 1–1 with 아스널. In the Second Division, 맨체스터 시티 move into the top three by beating 윔블던 3–0 and a Tommy Wright hat-trick helps 리즈 유나이티드 to a 5–0 win over 노츠 카운티.
The three times postponed FA Cup replay between 아스널 and 헤리퍼드 유나이티드 finally results in a 7–2 win for the First Division side.

선덜랜드 join 노리치 시티 in the Milk Cup semi-finals with a 1–0 win at 왓퍼드 while 퀸스 파크 레인저스 hold 입스위치 타운 to a goalless draw at Portman Road . In FA Cup replays, 토트넘 홋스퍼, 허더즈필드 타운 and 밀월 all make it through to round four, but 노리치 시티 and 버밍엄 시티 must try again after drawing 1–1 at Carrow Road.

Third Division 요크 시티 cause the biggest FA Cup upset of the season – a last-minute Keith Houchen penalty gives them victory over 아스널 at Bootham Crescent . 맨체스터 유나이티드 reserve goalkeeper Stephen Pears saves a Terry Gibson penalty in his side's 2–1 win over 코번트리 시티. In delayed third round replays, 블랙번 로버스 beat 포츠머스 2–1 and 첼시 win 5–0 at 위건 애슬레틱 with goal machine Kerry Dixon netting four. The 버밍엄 시티–노리치 시티 marathon continues as the two sides draw a second replay 1–1 at St Andrew's .
Ian Rush scores the only goal to give 리버풀 victory over 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the heavyweight clash of the FA Cup fourth round.

입스위치 타운 win 2–1 at 퀸스 파크 레인저스 in the Milk Cup but the fourth semi-finalist is still undecided as 첼시 are held 1–1 by 셰필드 웬즈데이. A goal credited to Steve Bruce at last sees 노리치 시티 overcome 버밍엄 시티 in the FA Cup third round.

셰필드 웬즈데이 and 첼시 draw a thrilling Milk Cup replay 4–4 at Hillsborough . 첼시 came from 3–0 down to lead 4–3 during normal time and then kicked off in both halves of extra time. In the FA Cup, 블랙번 로버스 win at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 윔블던 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 in a replay. Last season, as a Third Division club, the Dons knocked Forest out of the Milk Cup.
